content: {"like":["breezy, flashy, and entertaining feel of The Force Awakens","thrilling and well‑crafted story of Rogue One","terrific performances by the cast","dialogue free of laughable or groanworthy lines","breathless pacing throughout most of the film","visually intriguing Canto Bight sequence","strong, competent character of Rose Tico","compelling dynamic between Luke, Rey, and Kylo Ren","epic moments, especially Luke’s final scene","excellent cinematography and iconic shots","top‑notch visual effects with a respectful balance of practical and digital work","bold deconstruction of familiar tropes","refreshing change of pace for the franchise","dark, bleak tone with a high body count and dramatic kamikaze attack"],"dislike":["second quarter of the film stalls during the Canto Bight detour","clumsy handling of Leia’s space stunt","underdeveloped portrayal of Supreme Chancellor Snoke","underdeveloped newer characters such as DJ and the temporary female commander","forced and uncertain romantic hookup between Finn and Rose","some scenes felt forced or over‑extended"]}
